paragraphs: Rabbah bar Shumnei and Rav Menashya bar R' Yirmeyah of Difti were taking leave of one another. They said, ‘Let us say something the other has not heard.’ This is the reading in Yuhasin and Ein Yaakov; in the Gemara the reading is Abba. Eruvin 64a.
